verdict.rationale: Claude's MCP connector lets you connect remote MCP servers directly from the Messages API without a separate MCP client. You can configure which of their tools are enabled, allowlisted or denylisted. MCP tunnels extend this to servers running inside a private network. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP connector works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Claude's Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector feature enables you to connect to remote MCP servers directly from the Messages API without a separate MCP client
Flexible tool configuration: Enable all tools, allowlist specific tools, or denylist unwanted tools
MCP tunnels let you connect Claude to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that run inside your private network.
